ice_breakers.title: I just lost my job — what are my options?
How much does short-term coverage cost?

greeting.text:
Hey — thanks for reaching out. I'm David, a licensed health insurance broker. I help people find affordable coverage when they're between jobs.

Let me ask a few quick questions so I can match you with the best options in your state. Takes about 60 seconds.

ask_timeline.text: When did your coverage end (or when does it end)?

ask_income.text: Roughly what's your annual household income? This helps me check if you qualify for subsidized plans too.

collect_contact.text: Almost done — what's your first name and best phone number? I'll personally follow up with your options, usually within a few hours.

confirmation.text:
Got it, {{first_name}}! I'm pulling together options for your state right now. You'll hear from me shortly.

Need something faster? Call or text me directly: 863-640-3102

— David Huff, Licensed Insurance Broker

⚠️ Short-Term Medical plans are not ACA-compliant minimum essential coverage. Pre-existing condition limitations and state availability may apply.

notes.qualification_logic: Respondents who select 'Lost employer coverage' or 'On COBRA' with timeline within 60 days likely qualify for ACA SEP — flag for marketplace enrollment in addition to STM quote. Income under $45K for single or $65K for family strongly suggests APTC eligibility.
notes.top_states: Ad set targets: AL, AZ, FL, GA, IN, IA, LA, MS, MO, NE, OK, TN, WV. Quick replies show FL, GA, AZ (top population). Other captures remaining 10 states.
notes.compliance: STM disclaimer included in confirmation message. Do not promise specific savings or guaranteed coverage in any customization of this template.
notes.follow_up_sla: Recommend responding within 2 hours for highest conversion. Set up notification routing to ensure no lead sits overnight.
